CustomField.label: Advanced: Found Value (Formula)
CustomField.description: Optional. Used only when Check Type is Check fields on this record. A formula whose result is shown as the "Found" value on the result row (the left side of a comparison — what the record has). This is a formula, not a plain value. To show a fixed value, write it in formula syntax: text in double quotes ("Cold"), numbers bare with no commas (100), TRUE or FALSE, dates as DATE(2025,1,31), date/times as DATETIMEVALUE("2025-01-31 14:00:00"). A field on the record is its API name unquoted (NumberOfEmployees). The Pass Condition (Formula) still decides pass/fail. Leave blank for no Found value. Example: BLANKVALUE(Debit_Total__c, 0).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Formula for the Found value on the row (not a plain value). Fixed values use formula syntax: text "Cold", number 100, TRUE/FALSE, date DATE(2025,1,31). Pass/fail stays set by Pass Condition. Blank = no Found value.
